summary: Iter42 VA Success Batch 2 — 17 new backend tests written + executed (all pass) covering enhanced VA dashboard payload, /va/stale-leads (with 7-day backdate via direct mongo mutation), /va/leaderboard (period toggle + is_self flag), /va/templates + /va/coaching-notes (shared-only, no leak of private notes), /va/goals, PM va-goals upsert (incl. both-null deletes the row), PM templates CRUD (create/patch active=false archive/soft-delete/include_archived filter), PM coaching-notes CRUD (private + shared, admin sees both, VA sees only shared), /pm/vas/{id}/detail combined payload + 404 for non-VA, and permission boundaries (VA -> 403 on all /pm/* endpoints). Frontend E2E verified via Playwright: Admin VAs list links each VA name to /ops/va-program/vas/{id}; Admin Templates table renders new template + Archive/Delete buttons + 'Show archived' checkbox; Admin VA Detail shows Stats row, Monthly Goal editor pre-populated, Coaching note 'Shared' badge; VA Dashboard renders Monthly Goal card with progress bars, Pitch templates CTA, Leaderboard rank card with link to /va/leaderboard, and 'From your Program Manager' shared-notes card; VA sidebar has new Leaderboard + Templates tabs; VA Leaderboard has Week/Month/All time period toggle with crown on #1; VA Templates page has search input + Copy buttons; 403 enforced when VA hits /api/pm/templates and /api/pm/coaching-notes. Regression: iter39 (6) + iter40 (10) + iter41 (17) = 33/33 still green.

issues: When the requesting VA has 0 leads in the selected period, they are absent from the ranked list — so no 'You' badge appears for them. Acceptable UX, but consider rendering a 'You're not on the board yet — submit a lead to rank' footer row.
Pre-existing data noise: 'Iter41 VA' appears twice with identical stats (16 leads, 6.2% conv). Not a new iter42 defect — duplicate seed leftover from iter41 fixture lacking teardown.

critical_code_review_comments: pm.py is now 1179 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline ceiling. Recommend splitting templates + coaching-notes + va-goals into a separate routes/pm_va_success.py module to keep files focused.

va.py dashboard endpoint runs ~7 sequential DB queries (active count, commissions cursor, leaderboard aggregate, conversion counts, stale count, goal lookup, mtd commission cursor, shared notes cursor). On a busy preview this is fine, but consider asyncio.gather() to parallelize the independent queries.
GET /va/leaderboard masks earnings (good) but exposes other VAs' leads count and booked count to every VA. This is intentional per spec, just flagging for product awareness.

POST /pm/va-goals with both targets null silently deletes the row — the {ok:true,deleted:true} response shape is fine, but the API contract could be clearer (or a dedicated DELETE endpoint preferred for REST hygiene).
Test fixtures seed VAs but never clean up. Across 42 iterations this leaves hundreds of TEST_/iter*-va-* users + leads. Recommend a tearDown fixture that deletes by email prefix once per iteration.
test_credentials: admin@hcobcleaners.com / HcobAdmin2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). VAs seeded fresh per run via /api/pm/vas with @example.com domain.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests: 2 fresh VAs (iter42-va-*, iter42-va2-*), 3-5 templates (prefix 'TEST'), 3-4 coaching notes, 1-2 va_goals per test run. Frontend run: 1 VA (iter42-fe-va-*), 1 template 'TEST FE Hello', 1 shared note 'TEST FE shared coaching note', 1 goal for current month. No teardown — same pattern as iter41.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter42_va_success.py uses module-scoped admin/va/va2 session fixtures. Stale-leads test directly mutates va_leads.updated_at in MongoDB (reads MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env via local helper). Coaching-notes privacy test is the critical assertion — admin sees both private+shared, VA sees only shared. Backdated lead method (mongo updated_at = now-8d) is reusable for any 'staleness' tests. For frontend, you can hit /api/pm/* via page.request.post once admin session cookie is set. Note that REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported in shell when running iter39/40/41 (they don't read frontend/.env).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found across the 6 VA success features. All endpoints conform to documented shape & permissions; frontend renders all new sections correctly.
